name: The Northern Realms
author: Antigravity & Ancient Systems Designer
description: Winter tightens its grip over the fractured jarldoms of Valenfrost as old oaths fray and cold horrors stir beneath the barrow stones. Uncover the three lost Star-Keys of High King Valen, navigate rival halls and sunken marshes, and decide what fate awaits the North.

worldIntro.headline: Iron Oaths Beneath a Cracking Glacial Sky
worldIntro.text: Far north of the warm southern seas, jagged granite peaks and blue glacial rivers carve a hard country where jarldoms survive by timber palisades, hearth-fire, and sworn oaths. Around the mountain stronghold of Valenfrost, warriors, skald-scholars, and runic smiths still bargain with the Old Gods of the Hearth, drawing fragile spellcraft from carved runes and forging weapons from rare highland ores whose secrets reveal themselves only at the anvil. Beyond the keep's banners stretch iron-veined crags, mist-choked fens, barrow-haunted pine woods, and frozen passes prowled by frost-wolves, draugr, and ancient kin of winter. Deep beneath Mount Wyrmfang, something sealed away in the days of High King Valen has begun to stir the stone, and the North is running out of time to remember its forgotten covenants.

pillars.label: How the World Works
pillars.detail: Sworn jarldom oaths, Old God piety, harsh highland weather, and shifting northern alliances.

pillars.label: What Exists Here
pillars.detail: Runic spellcasting, material-driven smithing and alchemy, ancient barrows, and hidden sagas.

pillars.label: What Waits Beyond
pillars.detail: Glacial passes, iron crags, drowned fens, undead guardians, and the awakening beneath Wyrmfang.

startingJournalNotes: Arrived at the granite gates of Valenfrost amidst freezing highland winds. Earth tremors rumble from Mount Wyrmfang and Jarl Sigurd seeks champions to investigate the mountain portents.

easy.label: Skald's Tale (Easy)
easy.desc: Unlimited respawns at Valenfrost. Nothing is lost when you fall in battle.

normal.label: Shield-Brother (Normal)
normal.desc: Unlimited respawns; you lose 10 drachmae and up to a quarter of your unequipped supplies when defeated.

hard.label: Iron Thane (3 Lives)
hard.desc: Three sanctuary respawns before permanent defeat. Up to half your supplies are lost on fall.

extreme.label: Dragon's Feast (One Life)
extreme.desc: Permadeath. Falling in battle permanently ends the campaign.

labels.pantheon: The Old Gods of the Hearth

factions.name: The Iron Covenant
factions.description: Elite warrior fellowship based in the high mead-hall of Valenfrost. Sworn to martial honor, shield-drills, and monster-hunting across the reaches.

factions.name: The Whispering Cabal
factions.description: A shadowy guild of outlaws, fences, and cutpurses headquartered in the sunken cisterns below the Mistglen canals.

factions.name: The Circle of Winter
factions.description: Ancient order of northern sorcerers, enchanters, and element-binders presiding over the glacial Spire of Frostmere.

factions.name: Frostpeak Hold Guard
factions.description: Steadfast sworn guards and archers maintaining order, collecting caravan tolls, and manning the ramparts across Valenfrost.

factions.name: The Silver Kin
factions.description: Proud dwarf clan and veteran prospectors working the deep argent lodes of Grimstone Mine and the Blackforge.

factions.name: Order of Drakenseekers
factions.description: Dedicated slayers of legendary behemoths and ancient wyrms, preserving runic armaments and dragon lore.

factions.name: Drowned Mire Marauders
factions.description: Ruthless brigands and deserters lurking in the fog-drenched reed beds of Mistglen Bog.

factions.name: The Vyr Worshippers
factions.description: Chthonic death-cult seeking the awakening of the dormant Frost Wyrm beneath Mount Wyrmfang.

stalk.title: White Wolf Stalk
stalk.subtitle: Creep across the snowdrifts without disturbing the drifts
stalk.successText: You bag a mountain hare in the snowdrifts.
stalk.perfectText: Unseen and silent as falling snow! You retrieve game and prize white wolf fur.
stalk.failText: Cracking twigs betray your approach and the quarry scatters.

mortar.title: Northern Alchemist's Mortar
mortar.subtitle: Grind winter lichen and pine sap for healing unguents
mortar.perfectText: A steaming amber draught of hearthfire elixir!

astragaloi.title: Torvald's Runic Knucklebones
astragaloi.subtitle: Cast the carved mammoth bones upon the hearth slate

forge.title: The Blackforge Anvil Strike
forge.subtitle: Hammer glowing river-iron into tempered steel

shield_clash.title: Huscarl's Shield Clash
shield_clash.subtitle: Lock shield rims to deflect crushing blows

glyph_memory.title: Barrow Rune-Stone Echo
glyph_memory.subtitle: Repeat the ancestral Star-Key runes humming across the weathered cairn
glyph_memory.successText: The barrow stone vibrates warmly, yielding crystalline Frost Quartz.
glyph_memory.perfectText: Flawless runic mastery! A glint of pure Northern Silver surfaces from the cairn.

pendulum_tune.title: Grimstone Seam Calibration
pendulum_tune.subtitle: Strike three resonant ore veins along the deep dwarven shaft
pendulum_tune.successText: The chisel rings true along the seam, freeing solid Bog Iron.
pendulum_tune.perfectText: Pitch-perfect dwarven strike! A rare nugget of Sky-Iron Ore breaks cleanly free.

transcript.speaker: World Consequence
transcript.text: Jarl Sigurd falls upon the hearthstones of Valenfrost! The huscarl horns sound a call to arms across the entire hold.

addJournalChronicle.title: Fall of the Jarl
addJournalChronicle.text: Jarl Sigurd Wolf-Mantle was slain in his own hall. Valenfrost is plunged into martial lockdown.

transcript.speaker: World Consequence
transcript.text: Captain Tor falls at the city gate. Watchmen draw their bows and seal the portcullis.

tutorials.title: Arrival at Valenfrost
tutorials.summary: Speak with Captain Tor at the Gates, seek Jarl Sigurd in the High Mead-Hall, experiment with concealed material crafting at Bjorn's forge, and grow your Mythology & Lore and Intelligence to expand your combat spellcasting.
